stopPoints.label: Peppa introduces her family
stopPoints.question:
Question (Family): 'Look at Peppa's family! Who is wearing green glasses?'
Options: 'A) Daddy Pig 🐷 B) George 👶'
Guidance: Encourage the child to answer: 'Daddy Pig!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa and her family are going to the beach
stopPoints.question:
Question (Location): 'Where is Peppa's family going today?'
Guidance: Model the sentence: 'They are going to the beach! 🏖️'

stopPoints.label: Mummy Pig checks beach items
stopPoints.question:
Question (Object Recognition): 'Look at Mummy Pig's hands. What is she holding?'
Options: 'A) Buckets and spades 🪣 B) An ice cream 🍦'
Guidance: Guide the child: 'Buckets and spades!'

stopPoints.label: Putting on sun cream
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action/Why): 'The sun is very hot ☀️. What does Peppa need to put on?'
Guidance: Encourage the child: 'Sun cream!'

stopPoints.label: Playing with the spotty ball
stopPoints.question:
Question (Pattern/Color): 'Look at the ball! What pattern does it have?'
Options: 'A) Stripes 🦓 B) Spots / Dots 🔴'
Guidance: Say: 'It is a spotty ball!'

stopPoints.label: George cannot catch the ball
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Can George catch the ball?'
Options: 'A) Yes, he can. B) No, he cannot.'
Guidance: Prompt the child: 'No, he is too little!'

stopPoints.label: Putting on water wings (armbands)
stopPoints.question:
Question (Color/Object): 'Look at George's arms. What color are his water wings?'
Guidance: Guide the child to say: 'They are green! 🟢'

stopPoints.label: Going into the sea
stopPoints.question:
Question (Feelings/Temperature): 'Is the sea water cold or warm?'
Guidance: Elicit the line: 'It is lovely and warm! 🌊'

stopPoints.label: Splashing in the sea
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action): 'What are Peppa and Daddy Pig doing in the water?'
Options: 'A) Sleeping 😴 B) Splashing water 💦'
Guidance: Say: 'They are splashing water! Splash! Splash!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa asks to bury Daddy Pig
stopPoints.question:
Question (Polite Request): 'Peppa wants to play with Daddy. What magic word does she say?'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Please! Please, Daddy!'

stopPoints.label: Burying Daddy Pig in the sand
stopPoints.question:
Question (Body Parts): 'Daddy Pig is buried in the sand! Can you point to his nose or ears?'
Guidance: Ask the child to touch their own nose/ears and say: 'Only his head is out!'

stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig asks for his hat
stopPoints.question:
Question (Clothing): 'Daddy's head is hot. What kind of hat does he want?'
Options: 'A) A straw hat 👒 B) A winter hat ❄️'
Guidance: Guide the child: 'A straw hat!'

stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig falls asleep
stopPoints.question:
Question (Yes/No): 'Is Daddy Pig sleeping now?'
Options: 'A) Yes, he is. B) No, he isn't.'
Guidance: Encourage a full answer: 'Yes, Daddy Pig is sleeping! Shh...'

stopPoints.label: Making sandcastles
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action/Process): 'Where do they put the sand first?'
Guidance: Prompt the child: 'In the bucket! 🪣'

stopPoints.label: The sandcastle is finished
stopPoints.question:
Question (Magic Word): 'When the castle is ready, what fun word does Peppa say?'
Guidance: Encourage the child to repeat enthusiastically: 'Hey presto! ✨'

stopPoints.label: Time to go home
stopPoints.question:
Question (Routine): 'Mummy Pig calls them. Is it play time or home time?'
Guidance: Guide the child: 'It is home time! 🚗'

stopPoints.label: Checking the beach gear
stopPoints.question:
Question (Memory/Observation): 'Mummy Pig checked the towels and bags. Did they forget someone?'
Guidance: Prompt the child with a smile: 'Yes! They forgot Daddy Pig!'

stopPoints.label: George remembers Daddy Pig
stopPoints.question:
Question (Characters): 'Who remembered Daddy Pig?'
Options: 'A) George 👶 B) Peppa 👧'
Guidance: Encourage the child: 'George remembered Daddy Pig!'
